summary_1line: Rama kills Vali during his duel with Sugriva; Sita suffers captivity in Ashoka grove while Trijata consoles her with a prophetic dream of Ravana’s downfall.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama releases a powerful arrow from the forest that pierces Vali in the chest while he fights Sugriva amid shattered trees and stones.
Sita sits thin and sorrowful beneath Ashoka trees, surrounded by grotesque Rakshasa women with strange eyes and weapons.
Trijata recounts her dream of Ravana shaven and smeared with oil sinking into mire while Vibhishana rises crowned beneath a white umbrella.
